description: 1981 is the Year of the Metal Rooster in the Chinese zodiac, from February 5, 1981 to January 24, 1982. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1981 is the Year of the Metal Rooster, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 5, 1981 and ended on January 24, 1982, so people born in 1981 before Feb 5 belong to the Metal Monkey year.

sections.heading: When the 1981 Metal Rooster year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1981 Metal Rooster year began at Lunar New Year on February 5, 1981 and lasted until January 24, 1982, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Feb 5 1981 therefore belongs to the Metal Monkey year that started in 1980, while someone born in early 1982, up to Jan 24, is still a Metal Rooster. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Metal Rooster combination also falls in 2041, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1981 fell on a Thursday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Metal Rooster personality
paragraphs: Principled, focused and tirelessly hardworking, the Metal Rooster notices every detail. The Rooster's fixed element is Metal, so this year doubles it, and tradition describes precision at its sharpest. People born now are often honest, brave and self-reliant. Perfectionism and outspoken criticism are the usual cautions, softened by praising as readily as correcting. Their reliability, in work and friendship alike, is often unmatched.

Metal is the element of autumn and harvest, and a Metal year is traditionally said to sharpen whatever animal it meets. Descriptions associate it with determination, discipline, clear judgement and a strong code of principle. Metal-year people are often portrayed as decisive, self-reliant and willing to do difficult things because they are right. The element is linked with refinement and with cutting away what is unnecessary, so it tends to bring focus and high standards. Its traditional shadow is rigidity: Metal can become inflexible, proud or emotionally guarded, preferring to be correct over being close, and finding it hard to bend once a position is taken.

sections.heading: 1981 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits reduce to 1, the number of beginnings, initiative and independence, so numerologists describe a 1 year as one that rewards starting things. The digits of 1981 add up to 19, which reduces to 1. In the twelve-year cycle the Rooster is the tenth animal, earthly branch You, with Metal as its fixed element and Yin polarity. The year element is Metal, and in the five-element cycles metal year element matches the fixed element. The year before was the Metal Monkey and the year after is the Water Dog.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Xin-You: Xin is the Metal heavenly stem and You is the Rooster's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yin stems only ever meet yin animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1981?
faq.answer: 1981 is the Year of the Metal Rooster. It started on February 5, 1981 and ended on January 24, 1982.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1981?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 5. Born before February 5, 1981, you are a Metal Monkey; born on or after it, you are a Metal Rooster.

faq.question: What element is 1981 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Metal, a Yin year. The Rooster's own fixed element is Metal; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1981?
faq.answer: Xin-You. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Metal Rooster year?
faq.answer: 2041, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2041.
